from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFundRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial record regarding monetary funds."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company in the report")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code if mentioned in the report")
    monetary_funds_amount: float = Field(description="The monetary funds balance value extracted from the report")
    report_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. Q1 2024")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_fund_records: list[CompanyFundRecord]
